why: The heuristic's next rung under the defense buff ceiling of ADR 0076, from search-23, with stun-first back in the panel. Search 23 learned the panel it was searched on: on 200 unseen seeds from 995317 it takes every match from greedy and search-21 and beats the lookahead with lookahead-20 0.685, but stun-first, left out of that panel, holds it to 0.560 where search-21 took every match (journal, 2026-09-24). The panel is greedy, search-23 itself and stun-first, a candidate ranking last if it falls below the start against any: against search-23 the start scores the mirror's 0.5, so a candidate has to beat the set it came from to rank, and it cannot trade stun-first away again. The check, off that line and off the heuristic's reading, is the lookahead with lookahead-20, the one agent search-23 does not dominate by much; it is played only in the replay, because a match against the lookahead costs several times one against a heuristic and run 22 ran out of time with it in the panel. The budget is 8 rounds of 12, seed 0: run 21 played 129 candidates against a panel of three heuristics in 1h59, and matches under the ceiling run longer, so 97 leave the replay against the lookahead inside three hours. What would make it a rung: a set that beats search-23 and stun-first on seeds it never saw without falling below search-23 against greedy or the check. The search scores wins, not length, so whether its own mirror still reaches the cap is read on the hold-out.
